title: Duckzi's Raccoons
description: This project adds raccoons to your minecraft world!
body:
![Logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/84cf1aacdab90c31a993a1df1e697a578c59e62e.png)

# ABOUT
Duckzi's Raccoons adds a cute new critter to minecraft: Raccoons! An addition to the Duckzi's Critters collection, raccoons are passive wild mobs that add a new mechanic to the game!
# REQUIREMENTS
For the mod to work correctly, make sure you have [GeckoLib](https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib) installed!
# FUNCTIONS
Raccoons are a new mob which spawn mainly in forests and near villages!

<details>
<summary>Behavior</summary>

Be careful with your chests! Raccoons might smell something they like and steal from them if they are left in the open! Once stolen, they will hide away your stuff in the a new block called the Raccoon Stash.

![A raccoons stash](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/649e63c33b312adc92840c2263f8b6019a0a5b8f.png)
</details>
